title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational messages now supports hybrid-joined devices
summary: The hybrid-joined support, roadmap dates, licensing and API calls are supported. The message-management note incorrectly says Microsoft provides no individual action steps, although the reference gives approval and copying procedures; narrow that statement to cancellation and deletion. Two navigation paths also need minor clarifications.

claims.claim: The Intune path through Devices, Configuration, New Policy and Settings catalog reaches Enable delivery of organizational messages (User).
claims.quote: Under Platform, select Windows 10 and later. Under Profile type, select Settings catalog. Select Create. ... In the Configuration settings page, select + Add settings. ... select Experience ... Enable delivery of organizational messages (User)
claims.fix: Use the fuller path 'Devices > Manage devices > Configuration > Policies > Create > New Policy > Windows 10 and later > Settings catalog > Create > Basics > Configuration settings > Add settings > Experience > Enable delivery of organizational messages (User)'. State in the note that after adding it, close Settings picker and set it to Allow in Configuration settings, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/misc/organizational-messages-microsoft-365.
